configDefinition.name: sync_server
configDefinition.description: URI of the synchronization server coordinating playback across the two screens.

configDefinition.name: sync_group
configDefinition.description: Group identifier so both screens in the pair stay in sync.

configDefinition.name: items
configDefinition.description: JSON array of video objects ({uid, uri}) — this screen's pre-sliced segments. Required. Both screens must list the same uids in the same order so they wait on the same sync barriers; only the uri differs per side.

configDefinition.name: placement
configDefinition.description: Which half of the wall this screen displays. Labels the screen in the log and diagnostics; the content itself comes from `items`. Defaults to left.

configDefinition.name: mode
configDefinition.description: Debug shows the playback-status readout and on-screen log console; production hides everything except the title and device-info section. Defaults to production.
